objective: Prepare a source-backed maintenance handover; do not perform or claim repairs.

snippets.text: Kitchen tap: five drops counted during one minute after closing. No inspection of seals or pipes has been performed.
Hallway light: flickered twice on Monday evening. No electrical measurements or electrician assessment are available.
Bathroom extractor: the filter was cleaned on Sunday. There is no before-and-after airflow measurement.

required: Separate observed facts from hypotheses and proposed checks
Preserve the counts and uncertainty in the source snippets
Include suggested next steps with an unassigned owner unless one is actually supplied
State that no repair or outcome has been verified
forbidden: Diagnosing an electrical fault as established fact
Inventing a person, deadline, cost or completed repair
